chunks.heading: Melting Away
chunks.notes: Daniel receives the coercive text, faces his father's control and the boring/party ultimatum, and decides to go -- a classic opening dilemma poised at a threshold.

chunks.heading: Melting Away
chunks.notes: Daniel's self-conscious mirror moment and removing his glasses (impairing his own vision) followed by his nervous approach and first "warning sign" (the vomiting student) at the frat house door.

chunks.heading: Melting Away
chunks.notes: Matty and Ralph corner Daniel with a too-tight grip, then the catalogued party wrongnesses (drugs, chanting, pills) stack up as he's pressured to drink.

chunks.heading: Melting Away
chunks.notes: Hallucinatory melting/warping perception and forced pills lead to Matty's cruel reveal that she orchestrated his suffering for her own enjoyment.

chunks.heading: Melting Away
chunks.notes: Daniel's collapse is followed by the officer's fatalistic shrug and Matty's faked concern masking her satisfaction as she moves on to her next target.

chunks.heading: Melting Away
chunks.notes: The verbatim repeat of the opening line, now sent by Matty to her next victim, closes the story on its own cycle.
